newsitem.title: UK: Premier extends loss after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Premier extends loss after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Premier Farnell Plc dropped in early trading on Thursday, extending Wednesday's losses after its profit warning late yesterday.
The stock was down 81p at 551-1/2 by 0819 GMT, after yesterday falling 59-1/2p.
The electronics components supplier said on Wednesday that pretax profit for the year ending February 2 would fall short of market forecasts by as much as eight percent.
The group blamed strengthening sterling and problems at its distribution arm for the expected shortfall in earnings.

But the influential Financial Times Lex column said on Thursday that Farnell may have been too generous in its assumptions on market growth when trying to justify its 1.7 billion stg takeover of the U.S. firm Premier last year.
The newspaper said so far shareholders had seen none of the strategic benefits they were promised.
Elsewhere in the sector, shares in competitor Electrocomponents were down 5p at 433p by 0901 GMT.
